presets.provenance: Acceleration bands smooth high/low envelopes expanded by relative intrabar range; the middle line is the close SMA.
Awesome oscillator = fast SMA(median price) - slow SMA(median price).
Absolute price oscillator = fast EMA - slow EMA.
Aroon up/down measure the age of the most recent high and low over period + 1 observations.
Aroon oscillator = Aroon up - Aroon down.
Average true range uses Wilder smoothing of max(high-low, abs(high-prevClose), abs(low-prevClose)).
Volatility bands are a rolling mean plus/minus a configurable population standard deviation multiple.
CCI = (typical price - its SMA) / (0.015 * mean absolute deviation).
Chaikin oscillator = fast EMA(ADL) - slow EMA(ADL), using money-flow volume.
Chaikin money flow = rolling money-flow volume / rolling volume.
CMO = 100 * (rolling gains - rolling losses) / (rolling gains + rolling losses).
DEMA = 2 * EMA(source) - EMA(EMA(source)).
Disparity index = 100 * (value / SMA(period) - 1).
Directional movement exposes +DI, -DI, and Wilder-smoothed ADX derived from true range.
DPO subtracts the current period SMA from the source shifted back floor(period / 2) + 1 rows.
EMA seeded by the first complete period mean, then alpha = 2 / (period + 1).
Ichimoku derives conversion/base midprices and forward-displaced span A/B cloud bounds.
Keltner channels use an EMA center and Wilder ATR multiplied above and below it.
Klinger oscillator is the fast/slow EMA difference of trend-sensitive volume force plus a signal EMA.
Rolling least-squares value at the final index in each period window.
Arctangent of the rolling least-squares slope, in degrees.
Rolling least-squares intercept over index 0 through period - 1.
Rolling least-squares slope over index 0 through period - 1.
MACD = fast EMA - slow EMA; signal is an EMA of MACD; histogram is their difference.
Money flow index applies an RSI-style ratio to signed typical-price volume flows.
Momentum = value - value[period].
Normalized ATR = 100 * Wilder ATR / close.
On-balance volume cumulatively adds or subtracts volume according to close direction.
Price channel uses rolling high/low extrema and their midpoint.

warmUp.rows: 1 row, or one complete configured session

presets.provenance: Classic pivot, support 1, and resistance 1 derive from the previous row or previous configured session HLC.
Percentage price oscillator = 100 * (fast EMA - slow EMA) / slow EMA.
Price envelopes are a rolling mean shifted by a configurable percentage.
Parabolic SAR is a bounded acceleration-factor trend state machine over high and low.
Rate of change = 100 * (value - value[period]) / value[period].
Wilder RSI with an arithmetic seed and Wilder-smoothed gains and losses.
Slow stochastic smooths range-position %K and then smooths its %D signal.
Arithmetic rolling mean over period values.
Stochastic uses close position in the rolling high-low range and a signal SMA.
Supertrend uses recursive ATR bands and close crossings to maintain trend direction.
TEMA = 3 * EMA1 - 3 * EMA2 + EMA3.
One-period percentage rate of change of a triple EMA.
VWAP is cumulative typical-price times volume divided by cumulative volume within calculation state.
Williams %R = close position in the rolling high-low range minus 100.
Linearly weighted rolling mean with weights 1 through period.
Zigzag retains confirmed extrema after a configurable percentage reversal threshold.

principles: Theme controls visual tokens and defaults, never family semantics or renderer availability.
Capability profiles describe renderer, interaction, accessibility and data behavior.
Family modes and recipes own data meaning, transforms and layout.
Aliases converge on one canonical implementation and never create a second renderer path.
Unavailable capabilities produce an explicit error, warning or documented fallback instead of a silent semantic downgrade.
A planned or research contract is never described as current runtime support.

commonFoundations.summary: Ordered function-free transforms, top-level and layer pipelines, deterministic row lineage, parameters, seeded operations, aggregation counts, named sources, reusable branches and a shared transform DAG are supported.

A closed portable encoding map, conditional mark channels, geographic and trading channels, 17 positional/categorical/probability/temporal scale types, four color scale types, and shared or independent multi-view domains, axes, legends and colorbars are supported.

A closed immutable v1 store, union/intersection semantics, point/interval/rectangle/axis/lasso state, Canvas pointer/touch and keyboard-authored geometry, continuous and categorical pixel/domain navigation, linked multi-view state, and lineage-preserving selection-driven filtering are supported. Spatial analytic selection remains a separate later boundary.

Legacy flat layers and the closed layer/facet/repeat/hconcat/vconcat/concat/inset Canvas composition grammar are supported with deterministic bounded layout, scoped semantic and lineage identities, named axes, shared or independent multi-view domains/axes/legends/colorbars, linked view state, per-layer transforms, z-order and clipping. Facet virtualization, renderer mixing and Spatial composition remain later roadmap work.

All Canvas families compile a bounded lineage-aware semantic index and expose a virtualized native explorer with full roving traversal, focus-ring, tooltip and selection synchronization. Spatial GPU views expose projected roving traversal and active-descendant synchronization, while a bounded stable-key focus store links Canvas and Spatial views through a portable authored contract.

All 41 Canvas families support function-free reusable markLabels with stable-key portable positions, deterministic automatic collision placement, connectors, editing handles, pointer drag, keyboard selection and nudging, grid/mark/plot snapping, bounded undo/redo, runtime import/export events and accessible instructions/live status. Annotation adds a closed data-coordinate point/rule/band/label/callout registry with drag, resize and history.

Stable-key append/upsert/replaceLast uses bounded ring storage, explicit reject/drop-oldest/coalesce queues, count/event-time retention and replay. Row-local transforms recompute changed keys with exact global fallback; the frame runtime adds RAF coalescing, cancellation, pause/follow-live and lazy bounded history. Automatic module Workers accept row, typed-column and Arrow-compatible binary envelopes, injected JavaScript/WASM adapters and worker-owned renderers with bounded work and cancellation.
